plants.name: Calla lily
plants.notes: Not a true lily: oral irritation rather than kidney injury.

plants.name: Canna
plants.notes: Not a true lily despite the name.

plants.name: Cat grass
plants.notes: Sold specifically for cats, but not found in the reviewed toxicity source. Keep it to its own pot and ask your veterinarian.

plants.name: Cat thyme
plants.notes: Not found in the reviewed toxicity source.

plants.name: Catnip
plants.notes: ASPCA lists catnip as toxic to cats (vomiting and diarrhoea in large amounts). Many owners offer small amounts; ask your veterinarian.

plants.name: Chives
plants.notes: Allium: red blood cell damage with larger or repeated exposure.

plants.name: English ivy
plants.notes: Also invasive in many US regions.

plants.name: Foxglove
plants.notes: Cardiac glycosides.

plants.name: Rose of Sharon
plants.notes: ASPCA’s listing covers Hibiscus syriacus; other hibiscus species were not reviewed.

plants.name: Inch plant
plants.notes: Mainly a skin irritant.

plants.name: Jasmine
plants.notes: True jasmine (Jasminum) only. Carolina jessamine (Gelsemium) is a different, toxic plant.

plants.name: Kalanchoe
plants.notes: Cardiac glycosides (bufadienolides).

plants.name: True lilies
plants.notes: Even pollen groomed off fur can cause kidney failure. Keep every true lily away from cats, indoors and out.

plants.name: Lily of the valley
plants.notes: Cardiac glycosides.

plants.name: Oleander
plants.notes: Cardiac glycosides.

plants.name: Parsley
plants.notes: Photosensitisation reported.

plants.name: Peace lily
plants.notes: Not a true lily: oral irritation rather than kidney injury.

plants.name: Peruvian lily
plants.notes: Not a true lily despite the name.

plants.name: Pot marigold
plants.notes: Calendula only. French and African marigolds (Tagetes) are different plants.

plants.name: Rose
plants.notes: Thorns can injure eyes and paws in a small enclosure; choose thornless varieties.

plants.name: Sago palm
plants.notes: Liver failure is reported; seeds are the most toxic part.

plants.name: Silver vine
plants.notes: Not found in the reviewed toxicity source.

plants.name: Spider plant
plants.notes: Cats often chew the leaves; mild stomach upset from eating plenty of any plant is common.

plants.name: Valerian
plants.notes: Not found in the reviewed toxicity source.

plants.name: Wheatgrass
plants.notes: Not found in the reviewed toxicity source.

plants.name: Yucca
plants.notes: Sharp leaf tips are an injury risk in tight spaces too.
